_comment: USD per million tokens. Bundled with the app on purpose: burn must work on a machine that has nothing else installed. Verified 2026-09-13. Cache reads bill at ~0.1x input; cache writes at 1.25x (5-min TTL) or 2x (1-hour TTL).
_unknown_model_policy: A model with no entry is counted in tokens and excluded from cost, and the UI says so. Guessing a price would silently corrupt the only number this app exists to report.
